name: Seed Junky | 1g Pre-Roll | Concha
description: Concha hits like a warm, toasted Mexican sweet bread—think buttery, sugary crust with deep undertones of earthy spice and a smooth, gassy exhale. Much like a Cap Junky or other "Junky" crosses, it offers a dense, resinous profile that smells of ripe fruit and pungent diesel. The experience is a 1-2 punch: an intense, tingly head rush that slowly melts into a focused, positive mood and long-lasting physical ease. It’s a rich, comforting classic that balances high-end potency with a refined, bakery-fresh flavor.
